mapper.select: select module_id as moduleId, code, name, category, owner, summary, status, order_num as orderNum, visible, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from threebase_module where visible = '0' order by order_num asc, module_id asc

select feature_id as featureId, module_code as moduleCode, code, name, type, status, description, tags, fields, order_num as orderNum, visible, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from threebase_feature where module_code = #{moduleCode} and visible = '0' order by order_num asc, feature_id asc
select count(1) from threebase_module where code = #{code}
select count(1) from threebase_feature where code = #{code}
mapper.insert: insert into threebase_module(code, name, category, owner, summary, status, order_num, visible, create_time, update_time) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{owner}, #{summary}, #{status}, #{orderNum}, #{visible}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update threebase_module set name = #{name}, category = #{category}, owner = #{owner}, summary = #{summary}, status = #{status}, order_num = #{orderNum}, visible = #{visible}, update_time = sysdate() where code = #{code}
mapper.insert: insert into threebase_feature(module_code, code, name, type, status, description, tags, fields, order_num, visible, create_time, update_time) values(#{moduleCode}, #{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{description}, #{tags}, #{fields}, #{orderNum}, #{visible}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update threebase_feature set module_code = #{moduleCode}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tags}, fields = #{fields}, order_num = #{orderNum}, visible = #{visible}, update_time = sysdate() where code = #{code}
update threebase_module set order_num = #{orderNum}, update_time = sysdate() where code = #{code}
update threebase_feature set order_num = #{orderNum}, update_time = sysdate() where code = #{code}
